svg.title: Inside Claude and on the command line. Three skills: /job-search:find-jobs discovers, validates and scores new openings; /job-search:job-report gives the report, queue and stats from stored jobs; /job-search:apply-jobs prepares applications and outreach drafts. Claude also invokes them on its own when you ask in plain language, for example: find today's best AI Product and APM jobs in Bengaluru. Ten MCP tools: get_search_queries, submit_job_listings, get_daily_report, get_application_queue, get_stats, list_jobs, draft_answers, draft_recruiter_message, list_resume_variants, record_application. The same pipeline runs without Claude Desktop through plugin.py with discover, report, queue, stats, outreach and resumes commands.

div.span: Discover, validate and score new openings
Report, queue and stats from stored jobs

div.p: “Find today's best AI Product and APM jobs in Bengaluru.” Claude calls get_search_queries, runs the searches, then submit_job_listings validates and scores the results.
